long_biography.plain_text:
Benaros built a varied technical and operating career around Cannes. A local profile identified him as a thermodynamics engineer and reported that he and his former wife ran the Brasserie du Port from 1995 to 2000. Patent records later named him as inventor of systems for electrical-energy storage and heat-pump technology.

He managed Benaros & Associates and became manager of Evidence Power Systems, whose activities cover the design, manufacture and sale of engines and turbines alongside marine maintenance. He also led Evidence Impulse, a transport-equipment venture that registered the QuattroProp marine-technology mark. He remains registered as manager of Evidence Power Systems.
